```{r lede calcs, include = F}

scf2022 <- scf_load(2022)

data <- scf2022
  
# Filter for Married (1) or Living with Partner (2)
# Partner in primary econ unit with shared finances
data <- scf_subset(data, x8023 %in% c(1, 2) & x7020 == 2)

# Sex and race variables
# Note we are focusing on first-stated race of each person
data <- scf_update(data,
                   p1_sex = x8021,
                   p2_sex = x103,
                   race1 = x6809,
                   race2 = x8049,
                   same_sex = p1_sex == p2_sex)

# Prevalence of same-sex couples  
samesex_tab <- scf_freq(data, ~same_sex)

# Subset to mixed-sex
data0 <- data
data <- scf_subset(data, same_sex == FALSE)
   
# Because of SCF data-swapping rules, p1 is ALWAYS the male in mixed-sex couples
data <- scf_update(data,
                   race_male = race1,
                   race_female = race2,
                   exogamous = race_male != race_female)



```
